steps.text: jei-pinyin-search: open the inventory so JEI's ingredient overlay is up (the harness's throwaway level is creative, so the inventory bind opens the creative inventory)

jei-pinyin-search: focus JEI's search bar. The preset pins key_key.jei.focusSearch to a plain key.keyboard.f ahead of a version:2975 line (JEI 10.2's own registered default for this bind carries a modifier, which a scenario pressing a bare key would not match), so the focus key here is F with no modifier
jei-pinyin-search: type the pinyin of 石头 (shi tou) one character at a time
